onboardingWelcomeTitle:
Wayarka yanzu 
 uwar garken game server
onboardingWelcomeSubtitle:
Mai watsa shiri Java Edition sabobin kyauta. 
 Babu PC da ake buƙata. Yi wasa da kowa.
onboardingStep1Body: Takarda tana aiki a cikin gida akan wayarka kuma tana amfani da ƙwaƙwalwar ajiyar da kuke da ita.
onboardingStep2Body: PocketCraft yana ba ku adireshi na musamman wanda abokai za su iya haɗawa da su.
onboardingStep3Body: 'Yan wasan Java Edition suna haɗa kai tsaye ta hanyar relay tare da ƙaramin juzu'i.
onboardingImportSubtitle: Kawo duniyar ku, plugins, da daidaitawa tare da ku. Babu farawa.
onboardingImportWorldBody: Fitarwa daga Aternos, ajiye ma'ajiyar bayanai a PocketCraft, kuma a ci gaba.
onboardingImportPluginsBody: Sake amfani da fayilolin .jar guda ɗaya. Tarin plugin ɗin ku yana motsawa tare da ku.
onboardingImportConfigBody: uwar garken.properties, whitelist, da samun damar ma'aikata sun kasance cikakke.
onboardingFeaturesTitle: Cikakken iko, daidai a cikin aljihunka
onboardingFeaturesSubtitle: Ba app ɗin da aka cire ba. Wannan shine ainihin kayan aikin uwar garken.
onboardingFeaturesBanner: Duk abin da kuke buƙata a wuri guda
onboardingFeaturesConsoleBody: Gudanar da umarni da duba rajistan ayyukan
onboardingCrossPlaySubtitle: PocketCraft yana goyan bayan wasan giciye na Java da Bedrock lokacin da aka kunna gada a saitin sabar ku.
onboardingCrossPlayJavaBedrockBody: Abokai akan PC da wayar hannu zasu iya shiga duniya ɗaya tare ta hanyar relay.
onboardingCrossPlayNoExtraAppBody: Raba adireshin uwar garken ku kuma 'yan wasa za su iya haɗawa daga bugu nasu nan da nan.

⚠️ Siffar Gwaji - Kunna da Naku Hankali

onboardingRegionSubtitle: Zaɓi uwar garken relay mafi kusa da 'yan wasan ku. Kuna iya canza wannan daga baya daga dashboard kuma.
